BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the Residential Planned Development No. 1140 and symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 18-F in the area bounded by:

a line 100 feet south of and parallel to West 74th Street;

the north-south public alley next east of and parallel to South Halsted Street;
a line 350 feet south of and parallel to West 74th Street;

a line 152 feet west of and parallel to South Emerald Avenue;

a line 360.1 feet south of and parallel to West 74th Street;

South Emerald Avenue;

the Belt Wabash Railroad; and

South Halsted Street

to those of M2-1 Light Industry District, which is hereby established in the area above
described.

SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.

Common Address(es): 7411-7447 S. Halsted St.
